# Hi, I'm Naqiao.

I'm studying Applied Business Analytics at Boston University. I like working with data, but I'm more interested in how people use it to solve business problems.

I made this website for my AD688 class. It is a place to share what I've learned about AWS, Spark, SQL, and a few projects from this semester.

## A quick note

I'm still learning the technical side of cloud analytics. A lot of this class was about trying things, running into problems, and figuring out how to fix them. I wanted the website to show that process without making it sound more complicated than it was.
